overview: The 29-year-old has broken nearly every bone in his body on his death-defying path to motorcross glory. Now, Travis is up against the biggest challenge of his professional career: to become a top competitor in NASCAR racing.
title: On Pace with Pastrana

overview: Set in 1980s Kowloon Walled City, where triads run rampant and corruption infects the police force, He Chusan dreams of studying hard and escaping the chaos. His plans collapse when Xia Liuyi, a triad deputy leader, forcibly pulls him into a criminal scheme. As conspiracies unfold and power struggles intensify, the two men move from reluctant allies to partners in revenge. He Chusan, a calculating yet deeply devoted financial strategist, and Xia Liuyi, a fierce but unexpectedly tender enforcer, find themselves fighting side by side. In a lawless city balanced between black and white, love becomes their most dangerous gamble. Can they carve out a path to survival for each other? Adapted from the hit novel by She Xie Dian Dian.
title: Sammy's Children's Day

overview: Diverse couples of both famous and unknown personalities set off on a journey across Asia. They have one euro per day and a big task - to be the first to reach the finish line! The contestants are given challenging tasks along the way, and while their relationships are put to the test, it is mainly their willpower that keeps them afloat. Only those who can handle the pressure, inclement weather and unexpected situations have a chance to win an attractive financial prize.
title: Asia Express

overview: A surreal comedy where Rafaela and her friends navigate an adolescence full of absurd and wacky situations while trying to save the world before they become adults
title: Rafaela y su loco mundo

overview: Once known as the "Love Master" for her proactive approach towards romance, Kamoi Hiyori becomes timid after a traumatic breakup with her university boyfriend, Sudo Kei. However, her life faces a drastic turn when she suddenly timeslips back to four years ago, when she was still a university student. Reunited with Kei, Hiyori vows to not date Kei again but her heart begins to waver after experiencing Kei's kindness and thoughtfulness she did not noticed before.
title: Bad Choice Good Love

overview: On Drinking Made Easy, Comedian Zane Lamprey has made a name for himself as a bit of a beer aficionado, hosting TV shows about regional drinks and drinking customs around the world. For this entry on his resume, he sticks to North America and visits popular bars, breweries and distilleries in cities from Portland, Maine, to Maui, Hawaii. Friend and sidekick Steve often joins Zane at the bars and breweries for drinks and food games, which involve who can eat the most within a time limit. Episodes also feature Six-Pack Challenges -- including keg throwing, beer pong and grape stomping -- with the winner receiving, you guessed it, six-packs of beer.
title: Drinking Made Easy

overview: Sakutaro's former colleague and No. 1 sales rival, Shizuka Kuji, saved him from danger when he was out having a good time one night. When Kuji left the company a step earlier than Sakutaro, he looked at him with envy, thinking that he must have a brilliant second career now. But when Kuji reunites with Sakutaro for the first time in eight years, his sarcastic personality is still the same, but for some reason, he is now working as a translator, looking languid and with long hair...
title: Life in Smokey Blue

overview: Donal MacIntyre is blasted, roasted, frozen and soaked on an epic journey to experience the wildest weather the planet can throw at him. In Wild Weather, the tough man of journalism meets his match in a new series exploring how the world's weather works. From a gruelling marathon in the heat of the Sahara to paragliding through the fury of the monsoon, MacIntyre is tested to the limit. Wild Weather explores the elements and hears from scientists investigating how the weather works, and those who are trying to tame it. Using state-of-the-art 3D graphics, this wild ride through the weather is brought terrifyingly alive.
title: Wild Weather

overview: The unfiltered docuseries gives voice to the OGs, the cultural architects, street legends, and self-made bosses who built empires from nothing. Through cinematic visuals and candid, character-driven conversations, Dash builds with those who've walked the walk, creating a space where game is given, not sold. From surviving the trenches to breaking generational curses, OG Stories captures the mindset, moments, and blueprint of those who've shaped culture and the communities connected to it.
title: OG Stories

overview: The project tells the story of the young prodigy painter Xi Meng of the Song Dynasty and his journey of growth as he eventually collaborates with Emperor Huizong to create the legendary masterpiece A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains. Within the imperial painting academy, Xi Meng fights side by side with the guard Aji through life-and-death trials; in a hidden chamber, he humbly studies under an unseen mentor he has never met; and in the imperial court, he boldly questions Emperor Huizong's mistakes in governing the realm. As these three figures—mentor, friend, and adversary—gradually converge into one identity, Xi Meng struggles through conflict and inner turmoil before reaching reconciliation. In the end, he merges himself with the painting, laying down a single stroke of brilliant blue-green that reverberates through the world.
title: Riding on the Wind

overview: Wealthy heiress Yu Ming and impoverished student Yang Jingzhi once loved each other deeply, but were forced to part when her family fell from grace. Five years later, Yang Jingzhi rises to become a rising tech tycoon, while Yu Ming struggles to make ends meet and repay debts. Everyone expects him to seek revenge, yet unbeknownst to them, he has never let go. Breaking through the barriers of status and time, the two find their way back to each other with renewed determination.
title: Everlasting Moonlight

overview: A pair of embroidered shoes kicks off the adventure of cultural relics expert Chen Youxi. A four-person team clashes repeatedly with tomb raiders while searching for the Lingxiao Pearl. Yet after securing the first Lingxiao Pearl, they realize they've stumble into an even greater conspiracy...
title: The Secret of the Lost Pearl

overview: President and Mrs. Obama wanted to honor America's 250th anniversary and celebrate the unique history of our nation on this special occasion. ...But then Larry David called.
title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness

overview: A family business under thread in Barcelona's Raval neighborhood explores how to survive an imminent buyout by an investment fund.
title: Ravalejar

overview: The series investigates allegations of abuse and psychological manipulation by former members of the Catholic group Heralds of the Gospel.
title: Escravos da Fé - Os Arautos do Evangelho

overview: Brash humor and genuine emotion make up this original series revolving around the lives, loves, ambitions, careers and friendships of a group of gay men and women living on Liberty Avenue in contemporary Pittsburgh, PA. The show offers an unapologetic look at modern, urban gay and lesbian lives while addressing the most critical health and political issues affecting the community. Sometimes racy, sometimes sensitive and always straight to the heart, Queer As Folk is groundbreaking television at its best.
title: Queer As Folk

overview: It Takes a Choir follows the dapper and charismatic British sensation Gareth Malone as he travels across the U.S. to unite an unexpected mix of characters through the spellbinding power of music. A true fish out of water, in both his environment and teaching style, Malone finds himself in the craziest situations with some of the biggest characters. Each episode culminates in a unified and powerful public performance from the choir in front of their family, friends and community.
title: It Takes a Choir

overview: This documentary series follows the story of Brazilian journalist Rose Leonel, who in 2006 became the victim of a massive leak of intimate photos and transformed her pain into activism, leading the fight against digital crimes in Brazil.
title: Nua na Rede: A Verdade Sobre Rose Leonel

overview: Qi Jiujiu transmigrates into a novel as an heiress engaged to Huo Xize, fated to die. She breaks the engagement and meets Huo Shenye, his younger brother—a villain who craves physical contact and vows to take everything from Huo Xize.
title: I Survive In The Villain's Arms Through Psychotherapy

overview: Restaurant singer Ksenia marries a military psychologist, who is soon sent to a hot spot. Pregnant Ksenia is thrown out onto the street by her husband's brother, without any documents. An underground doctor delivers the babies prematurely. Three girls are born. Ksenia cannot be saved. Twenty years later, under strange circumstances, the father will have to meet his daughters, the existence of whom he had no idea about.
title: Жребий судьбы

overview: The series follows Meryem, who holds onto life with nothing but good intentions, as she reunites with her one true love, Kadir—now a man whose world has been shaped by power, wealth, and ambition.
title: Çirkin

overview: This three-part docuseries chronicles the search for answers in the 1994 assassination of Mexican political candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio.
title: Los Asesinos de Colosio

overview: Jamie is heading off the beaten track to find the real underground food and meet up with the unsung heroes who make American food far more interesting and varied than its reputation allows. Rather than fancy restaurants and top chefs, he'll be meeting, and learning from, real cooks making honest food for working people at street stalls, off-road diners and down-to-earth local restaurants. Along the way, he's picking up delicious new recipes, experiencing tastes old and new, and learning how other cultures adapt when they come to the USA. From cowboys to alligator hunters, and ex-gang members to high-society ladies, Jamie wants to discover the real heart of America, through its people, culture, music and – most importantly - its food.
title: Jamie's American Road Trip

overview: Mohamed Salah Fakhr, an ambitious young man from a Delta village, strives to break into advertising, determined to prove that success depends on belief in a dream, not living in Cairo.
title: Fakhr El Dilta
Las Autenticas Aventuras del Profesor Thompson

overview: When Linus suddenly disappears without a trace one day, his closest friends gather to search. Why is Linus missing? And what has happened?
title: Tystnaden

overview: Amor Animal is an Argentinian Original, fictional drama series following Kaia, a trap artist from the outskirts of the city, who meets Nico, an upper-class young man with existential angst. Despite their different realities and the outside forces pushing them apart, they try to make space for their love to grow, and in doing so, unleash a gang war.
title: Amor Animal

overview: As a retired schoolteacher, Mr. Molina decides to become a judge in his local jurisdiction, a job he takes to relieve the court of minor cases, and in which he will have to deal with people from his neighborhood involved in petty crimes.
title: Monsieur Molina

overview: In Junkyard Empire, the hunt is on for big, washed up metal-cars, motorcycles, boats, homes, campers and heavy equipment-from police impounds, private auctions, dealers, random driveways or old lots. What might look like a rusted out beater to most people is pure gold in the seasoned eyes of Andy and Bobby as they hunt valuable parts, scrap metal or a potential high-end fabrication for their clientele. Once back at the junkyard its pure hustle-and-bustle chaos as cars are lifted, stacked, torched, stripped and scrapped. At the custom car shop the once ruined cars are brought back to life one panel and plug at a time transforming the trash into treasure for high dollar customers.
title: Junkyard Empire

overview: The four-part docudrama series David: King of Israel, hosted by Zachary Levi, premieres on Fox Nation on February 26, 2026. The series explores the life of the biblical King David, with new 45-minute episodes airing weekly. The dynamic life of King David: giant killer, renegade warrior, and unifier of Israel under his crown.
title: David: King of Israel

overview: Orphaned Shen Moran learned from a young age to hide her true self in order to survive. After being adopted, she was mistreated and exploited by her adoptive mother, but eventually broke free from her control and made her way to the entertainment industry. To climb higher, she strategically leveraged Lin Qian, who once bullied her, and allied with Su Nian, the biological heiress of a prominent family. Her boyfriend, Gu Yechen, saw the tenderness and sincerity beneath her fierce exterior and silently protected her all along. Just as Shen was on the verge of winning Best Actress, Gu Yechen was ambushed while saving her.
title: Beneath the Brilliance

overview: A misunderstanding brings software engineer Min Hui and CEO Xin Qi together, leading them into an unexpected love, until another misunderstanding tears them apart. Years later, fate brings them face-to-face again at work. As workplace tensions, regret, and lingering feelings collide, they are drawn into a bittersweet romance that leads them back to the love they never truly left behind.
title: Back to Your Heart

overview: Help! I Bought It at Auction with Sarah Beeny explores the drama, risk, and reward of buying property at auction. From bargain terraces to sprawling mansions—and even the occasional castle—each episode follows gripping real-life stories of buyers seeking a bargain and gambling their life savings in pursuit of their dream home. But with many properties in dire need of renovation, the journey is rarely straightforward. Behind every wall and beneath every floorboard could lie a costly surprise.
title: Help! I Bought It at Auction with Sarah Beeny

overview: When former psychotherapist Fai is hired to teach Happiness, a newly offered course aimed at helping students to get to know and understand themselves, she finds that nothing is as easy as she'd thought. A troubled student in her class, Kla, insists that happiness does not exist. Fai often finds herself helping him, despite what he wants. In her class, she also meets Miu, a depressed medical student; Win, Miu's perfectionist and controlling boyfriend; Good, a cheery freshie with no friends; and Chai, an electrical engineering student who identifies as a woman. Fai also reconnects with Itt, a popular friend from her high school days and former boyband member turned music professor. Though a matter from the past has erected walls between them, the two have to come together to help their students, particularly Kla, who's begun to find love and a sense of safety through Fai's class and the friends he's made. However, their progress is threatened as the class is attacked on social mead and Fai faces an investigative committee.
title: How to Suffer 101

overview: Taste in Translation is an international taste-trotting tour of the world's most popular and flavorful food. You'll travel far and wide, over a mouthwatering map of the most delicious dishes on the planet as well as our top American favorites. To find out the REAL favorites, we'll check out diverse locations from four-star restaurants, to food carts, to private homes. Both locals and culinary experts will share their passion for their country's most beloved dishes along with a bit of the history behind the dish, some technique tips, and cultural lore.
title: Taste in Translation

overview: The story of a renowned family of surgeons who hold significant power in Thailand's cosmetic surgery industry. Their enormous profits from the business become a source of internal conflict within the family. Especially between Dr. Thicha, the ambitious oldest sister, and Dr. Tan, the youngest brother struggling to find his place in the family. Meanwhile, the dangers of cyberspace are shown with Itthichai or "It," an expert programmer from a government agency, who must solve an mystery that links cybercrime to the dark side of the cosmetic surgery industry.
title: The Idol Game

overview: Do you think shopping should be considered an Olympic sport? Bargain hunt like it's a full-time job? Is retail therapy your form of … actual therapy? Then get ready for the shopping spree of a lifetime, because the new series Win the Mall is the ultimate fantasy retail experience. This high-stakes competition transforms a classic American shopping mall into a thrilling game of strategy and unexpected twists. Over the season, 10 teams of expert shoppers face off against each other as they attempt to gain control of storefronts, increase their spending power, and outmaneuver their rivals.
title: Win the Mall

overview: "Fah" Dujupsorn's mother M.L. Wilairampha remains resentful of M.R. Ronnaphi Juthathep for breaking a promise to marry her. Fah loves her mother so much that she is ready to take revenge on the Juthatheps; she is to apply for a job at a Juthathep-owned company and seduce M.L. Ronnaphum Juthathep to fall for her, only to hurt him. Ironically, it is Fah who falls in love; she is stunned when she meets the president of the company, Major M.L. Asira Juthathep, the eldest son of M.R. Tharathorn, as he is the charming and handsome soldier from her past who had once saved her life. She now faces the toughest decision of her life: revenge may not be her choice, but it is her destiny.
title: Dujupsorn

overview: The bright and beautiful cousins of Dhevaprom—Cheewan and Poncheewa—are close like sisters and do everything together, including studying in Switzerland. Meanwhile, M.L. Saruj Juthathep, son of M.R. Pavornruj and Princess Wanrasa, is the First Secretary of the Thai Embassy in Bern, whose job is to support Thai students. This is a perfect setting for romance, but not a love triangle. Things get complicated when Cheewan falls for Saruj while she is supposed to play Cupid for her Poncheewa and Saruj. They become entangled in a web of lies and jealousy that threatens to tear apart the cousins' once unbreakable bond. Will Cheewan follow her heart and be one with Saruj, or will she remain loyal to Poncheewa? For whom does Saruj harbour true feelings?
title: Poncheewan

overview: Cars began rolling off the assembly line over 100 years ago. Two billion vehicles later, we still can't get enough. The Cars That Drove Us takes viewers into Jeff Dunham's garage - home to 130 legendary cars. Joined by his cast of characters, Dunham reveals the storied history of era-defining rides, from the Corvette Stingray to the ill-fated Vector W8, as told by the engineers, artists, and socket slingers who built them.
title: Jeff Dunham's The Cars That Drove Us

overview: Empress Gu Qing, betrayed and perished in flames, is reborn as Feng Qing, a lowly seamstress in the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau. To protect her sister Gu Wan and uncover the truth behind her death, she navigates the treacherous harem, joining forces with her younger brother, Imperial Physician Gu Xuan. As she schemes amidst the palace's shadowy powers, her fate becomes inextricably tangled with Emperor Xiao Luo. Their bond rekindled with every confrontation.
title: Glory Back
Wo Xi Huan De Ren Bian Cheng Mao Shi Zen Yang De Ti Yan

overview: 50 players navigate a chaotic Mahal where rules don't exist. In this lawless game, alliances form and break, betrayals matter, and each turn affects all contestants.
title: The 50

overview: A workaholic home shopping host heads to the countryside to get her sales back on top, but a mysterious farmer shakes up her plans — and her heart
title: Sold Out on You

overview: Tripping Out with Alie & Georgia is the ultimate travel-buddy-comedy series. Best friends for years, this duo sets out across America to bring viewers a unique and authentic spin on the travel adventure and all the wild and crazy happenings along the way. At the end of each episode, the BFFs find clever ways to bring that experience home to share with friends, as well as toast them with a new, cool cocktail.
title: Tripping Out with Alie & Georgia
Koi ni Ochita Ohitori Sama: Stendhal no Renairon

overview: Adel, a young surveillance installer, secretly plants cameras for money and accidentally witnesses a murder, drawing him into a dangerous network of corruption that forces him to fight to protect his family.
title: Ein Sehreya

overview: An unexpected accident shatters a once-happy family, leaving Wen Xin as the sole survivor. By chance, she obtains a magical lantern that allows communication across time. Joining forces with Sun Wen from twelve days in the past, the two embark on a desperate race against time to save the family. As they attempt to change fate, the rescue becomes increasingly perilous, revealing that the accident was not a simple tragedy but the beginning of a web of hidden conspiracies and looming dangers.
title: Time Rescue

overview: Ji Bai, a gifted young physician, flees an arranged marriage only to run into a group of bandits—led by none other than her never-before-met runaway fiancé, Xiao Heyan. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the mismatched pair become entangled in mysterious illnesses and the hidden intrigues of a medicinal hall. As they navigate life-and-death trials together, unexpected feelings begin to grow. Yet just as the truth comes to light, Xiao Heyan falls into an eternal slumber, poisoned by a deadly gu toxin…
title: Runaway Healer

overview: Amid sweeping reforms in the mining industry, the quiet village of Dayang is thrust into turmoil. An ordinary villager, Yang Gang, is forced into the dangerous undercurrents of the mines in order to protect his family. Together with his brothers, he takes a desperate risk by venturing into a forbidden mine shaft, only to uncover a hidden secret tied to a gold deposit. From that moment on, he becomes entangled in a web of corruption and crime. As pressure mounts from the mine's authorities, rival factions clash both openly and in the shadows, and a series of misfortunes befall those around him. Caught between survival and moral integrity, Yang Gang faces increasingly difficult choices. Under the lure of "black gold," the battle between good and evil intensifies, and each decision he makes begins to shape the fate of the entire village. In the end, where will this high-stakes game surrounding the gold mine lead?
title: The Dark Gold
Dong Bei You Ge Zhou Dong Bei

overview: Narrated by Executive Producer Anthony Bourdain, The Mind of a Chef is that rare and beautiful thing: An intelligent show about cooking. Season three of the James Beard and Emmy-Award wining series from Zero Point Zero Production and presented by WGBH, enters the minds of chefs Edward Lee and Magnus Nilsson, and follows these two great culinary figures from their home kitchens to destinations around the globe in search of ingredients, inspiration and the perfect meal. As in the previous two seasons, featuring chefs David Chang, Sean Brock and April Bloomfield, The Mind of a Chef combines cooking, travel, history, humor, art and science into a cinematic journey, each episode capturing another glorious flicker from the mind of its subject and focusing on what it truly means to cook, think, create and live in the food-obsessed world that is The Mind of a Chef.
title: The Mind of a Chef
Chong Sheng Huang Nian Di Ping Jie Gui

overview: Broadcast Legend Christopher "Mad Dog" Russo gives the definitive take on the greatest debates in sports.
title: The Verdict

overview: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It follows a struggling novelist and single mom on the verge of losing custody of her kids, who is mistaken for an assassin and offered life-changing money for one kill.
title: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It

overview: After six years of success in European soccer, Gabo, Dedé, and Ricky decide to visit IAD, the Academic Sports Institute, which saw them grow up, and surprise them. But they are the ones who get the surprise: the IAD is not as it used to be and the Golden Hawks, the soccer team they were part of, is aimless, unmotivated, and on the verge of being relegates. Now they must restore the IAD's glory and the pride of being an Hawk: a new chapter begins, full of passion and plenty of soccer!
title: O11CE: Nueva generación

overview: After skyrocketing to fame as the host of *Morning Live* for just 18 months, Michaël Youn is finally back on M6, 20 years later. And since the network has given him free rein, you'll see that he hasn't lost any of his wildness or his irreverence.
title: Le Morning Night

overview: Kev Adams hosts a stand-up comedy show on the beach with various French comedians.
title: L'humour à la plage

overview: Ranking of 100 clips (bloopers, stunts, magic, or surprises) from 100th to 1st.
title: Les 100 plus grands...

overview: Best Food Ever takes viewers on a mouthwatering journey across America to the places that best satisfy any craving. Each episode counts down the top 10 destinations in a specific food category, highlighting what makes them the best and who is behind the dishes. "Sensational Sandwiches", "Bodacious Bakeries", "Darn Good Diners", and "Buzzworthy BBQ" are among the episode titles.
title: Best Food Ever

overview: Les Nuls The show is a comedy show modeled on Saturday Night Live with Les Nuls broadcast on Canal+ from October 13, 1990 to March 28, 1992. Les Nuls were accompanied by a guest actor who played their sketches with them and a musical guest who performed two songs live. The show was also full of fake ads and fake trailers, not to mention L'édition, a fake newscast presented by Maurice Chevalier (Alain Chabat) and Pénélope Solète (Chantal Lauby).
title: Les Nuls, L'émission

overview: Les mots d'Eric et Ramzy is a French comedy show featuring the iconic duo Eric Judor and Ramzy Bedia. It is a series of short, absurdist sketches where the duo plays with language and situations, typical of their surreal humor style.
title: Les mots d'Eric et Ramzy

overview: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him
title: Vikram On Duty

overview: As mysterious cases shake the martial arts world, Wuwang Pavilion offers Lu Xiaofeng a miracle cure for blindness if he can solve a series of impossible crimes. Determined to restore his best friend Hua Manlou's sight, Lu Xiaofeng takes on the challenge. From deadly flower curses and mysterious gambling houses to haunted islands and sinister desert inns, each case grows stranger and more dangerous. With his sharp mind, signature skills, and trusted allies including Hua Manlou, Ximen Chuixue and Sikong Zhaixing, Lu Xiaofeng uncovers the truth behind every mystery and ultimately stops a conspiracy threatening the entire martial world.
title: The Legend of Lu Xiaofeng

overview: Meantime follows Felix McAveety, a full-time addict whose best friend is found murdered in a Glasgow park, leaving him as the police's most convenient suspect. In a fog of intoxication and paranoia, Felix sets out to clear his name, enlisting the help of an ageing former Detective Inspector turned crime novelist and a chaotic friend. Their search for the truth becomes an exhilarating and frequently laugh-out-loud race through the murkier edges of contemporary Scotland, as events rapidly spiral out of control around him.
title: Meantime

overview: Zach Galifianakis digs into the world of gardening, interviewing curious kids and eccentric experts in a funny, oddball celebration of the food we eat.
title: This Is a Gardening Show

overview: The jewels of a great emperor, kidnappings, explosions and chases, acts of sabotage, a love that has endured through the years, separation and the discovery of happiness... Time and distance have separated them, the marriage of their beloved and only man to another, betrayal and mutual accusations, but perhaps Andrei and Tuan's dreams are destined to come true? Classmates and friends Andrei Voloshin and Oleg Vetrov compete in everything: love and work, even their affection for a young secretary. To Vetrov's chagrin, Voloshin always wins, the reason being his talent and ability to appreciate people, but Vetrov refuses to accept this. Immediately after graduating from college, the friends end up in Professor Gromov's experimental lab and travel with him to Vietnam to build a secret military bridge. These specialists from the Soviet Union are tasked with helping the Vietnamese recover from the war with the United States. There, they fall in love with a local translator, Tuan...
title: Единственный мужчина

overview: On Brother vs. Brother, watch as HGTV's Property Brothers go head to head in a battle to renovate a Las Vegas investment property. The brother with the biggest return on investment wins bragging rights — and the loser is on the hook to complete a humiliating dare.
title: Brother vs. Brother

overview: The future of fandom? Across Scottish football, ultras groups are transforming match days. Beyond the headlines of flares and trouble is a powerful sense of belonging for young men.
title: Ultras

overview: The iconic competition returns with each episode featuring weekend warriors from across the nation stepping into the Arena to face 16 powerful new Gladiators. From classic events like Joust, Powerball, Hang Tough, and The Wall, to high-impact new challenges including The Ring and Collision, every showdown demands pure grit, strategy, and heart. Only one man and one woman will conquer the Arena, claim $100,000, and earn the title of American Gladiator Champion.
title: American Gladiators

overview: Erik Follestad takes Josefine Engmann and Jonas Bariås on a trip to show you why he loves Norwegian ice hockey.
title: Folles verden

overview: Driven by a relentless hunt for the truth, Bustamante pulls back the curtain on modern-day mysteries that blur the line between fact and fiction. Using his unique perspective and insider techniques, he investigates, pressure-tests, and challenges prevailing narratives to reveal the hidden forces behind these events and the motives used to manipulate the truth.
title: Conspiracies & Coverups

overview: After mysteriously losing her parents as a child, a young woman infiltrates the family responsible, seeking revenge by tearing them apart.
title: Hypnotic

overview: Dokkaew lives with her father and stepmother. Afraid that her husband's money will go to her stepdaughter, Dokkaew's stepmother tried to kill them in an accident. While struggling to get up from the accident, which hurt her father, Dokkaew is again hit by a car driven by Chit's mother who takes her to the hospital where she is diagnosed with amnesia. Chit's mother takes Dokkaew to her own house and names her Kahlong. Chit believes that Kahlong is faking her amnesia to take advantage of his naive mother and is suspicious of her while being attracted to her as well. Dokkaew's friend who is trying to find her meets with Chit's sister without knowing the relationship.
title: Dokkaew Kahlong

overview: Six Atlanta moms give a whole new meaning to the term 'competitive motherhood'.
title: Pretty Wicked Moms
